title: Delegating outcomes instead of tasks, and the context that has to come with them

videos.script: Patients are getting two reminders for one appointment. Renata wants it fixed, and she gives it to Paula. {{title}} Her first message says exactly what to change. Which job, which column, how small it is. {{task}} That message keeps the thinking and hands over the typing. And her guess about the cause is wrong. {{wrong}} So she deletes it. The second message says what has to be true when Paula is done. One reminder per appointment, and a way to know if that stops. {{outcome}} This lesson is about the difference. What has to travel with an outcome, so a person can own it. {{context}} How much of a decision to hand over, from tell to delegate. {{ladder}} And the two ways it goes wrong. Grabbing the work back too soon. Or never looking at it at all. {{checkpoints}}
